title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.21767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas. Each task specifies the research objective and essential scientific constraints, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine how to generate and validate the evidence needed to answer the question. A 20-criterion Atomic Score measures local scientific accomplishment, while Research Closure (RC0--RC4) assesses how fully the investigation resolves the specified research question based on whether its indispensable evidence requirements and applicable scope conditions are satisfied. translated_title: 从研究目标到科学闭环：通过基于证据的物理研究评估智能体
translated_abstract: AI智能体能否组织起能够得出有充分证据支持的结论的科学研究？为评估这一能力，我们提出了PhysClosureBench，这是一个包含50个经专家验证、目标明确的物理研究任务的基准，涵盖强场物理、阿秒物理及相关物理领域。每个任务都规定了研究目标和关键的科学约束条件，同时让智能体自行组织研究过程，并决定如何生成和验证回答问题所需的证据。一个包含20项标准的“原子分数”用于衡量局部的科学成果，而“研究闭环”等级（RC0–RC4）则根据不可或缺的证据要求和适用范围条件是否得到满足，评估该研究在多大程度上完整解决了指定的研究问题。我们评估了七个前沿大语言模型，其中Claude-Opus-5获得了最高的平均原子分数（6.29/10），但仅有32.7%的尝试达到了RC4级别。
tldr: 该论文提出了PhysClosureBench基准，通过50个专家验证的物理研究任务和“研究闭环”评估框架，衡量AI智能体能否自主组织科学研究并得出证据充分、结论完整的科学闭环，发现即使最强的Claude-Opus-5也仅有32.7%的尝试达到最高的RC4等级。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified physics research tasks with a Research Closure (RC0-RC4) framework to evaluate whether AI agents can autonomously organize scientific investigations into fully evidence-supported conclusions, finding that even the strongest model, Claude-Opus-5, reaches RC4 in only 32.7% of attempts.
